2608.24327.title: Speech-to-SOAP: End-to-End Summarization of Medical Dialogues: KIT@BeTraC 2026
2608.24327.paper_summary: With the advent of Large Language Models and its instruction following capabilities a promising application is the task of summarization. Within this domain of task the extractive sub-task of clinical protocolling has emerged as a topic of particular interest as it can significantly reduce the downtime and protocolling burden of health-care workers thus enabling them to focus on their core work helping humans. A further step towards automation is the direct generation of clinical notes from speech without intermediate transcripts, reducing processing time while preserving information such as coughing or other paralinguistic cues that may be lost in transcript-based systems. To this end, we present KIT's submission to this years BeTraC challenge in the lightweight track. Our main contribution is a scalable data augmentation pipeline that unifies heterogeneous medical dialogue datasets through synthetic speech generation and automatically generated SOAP supervision, enabling robust adaptation of a speech foundation model for end-to-end speech-to-SOAP generation.
2608.24327.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型的出現及其遵循指令的能力，摘要任務成為了一個有前景的應用領域。在這個任務領域中，臨床協議的提取子任務已成為特別受關注的主題，因為它可以顯著減少醫療工作者的停機時間和協議負擔，從而使他們能夠專注於幫助人類的核心工作。邁向自動化的進一步步驟是從語音直接生成臨床筆記，而不需要中間的文字記錄，這樣可以減少處理時間，同時保留如咳嗽或其他可能在基於文字記錄的系統中丟失的副語言線索等信息。為此，我們提出了KIT在今年BeTraC挑戰賽輕量級賽道的提交。我們的主要貢獻是一個可擴展的數據增強管道，通過合成語音生成和自動生成的SOAP監督，統一異質的醫療對話數據集，使語音基礎模型能夠穩健地適應端到端的語音到SOAP生成。
